remarks: Stylish, sophisticated and fun, this stunning 10,000 SF westside country estate borders two acres of land trust for total privacy, and is conveniently located close to town and schools. Extensive and impeccable renovations in 2023 with exquisite details and millwork, superior quality craftsmanship, luxurious amenities, smart home technology, designer light fixtures, new mechanicals, new cedar roof and a harmonious palette offers the perfect oasis for comfortable living, working and entertaining. Highlights include 10 ft. ceilings, 6 fireplaces, private study/office, 1st and 2nd floor family rooms, dramatic two story entry, and a new show-stopping Christopher Peacock custom kitchen and butler's pantry with furniture quality cabinetry, super sized island, major high end appliances and a sun-drenched dining area. All seven spacious ensuite bedrooms have gorgeous new bathrooms. The fabulous master suite with sitting area/fireplace has an amazing custom dressing room and extraordinary bath. Just completed lower level has a wine cellar, gym, media room, ensuite bedroom, cabana bath and is walk out to the pool area. The expansive bluestone terrace with fireplace abuts the glorious pool area with spa that is surrounded by lush landscaping and nature's beauty. This is a forever turnkey home ready to warmly welcome its new owners.
